    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create/update it is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and
            that E.164 string is the stored/returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678'
            becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is normalized to lower-case, and the
            stored/returned value is that lower-cased string.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array

          minimum: 1

        totalElements:

          type: integer

          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

    PetPage:

      properties:
        content:

          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:

        size:

  KEY fk_username_idx (username),
  CONSTRAINT fk_username FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users (username)
) engine=InnoDB;

## Summary

I implemented `customerCode` assignment for owners, formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**How it works:** when an owner is created via `POST /api/owners`, the controller computes `LAST3` as the upper-cased first three letters of `lastName` and `NNNN` as a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current owner count, then persists and returns it (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

**Files changed:**

- **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, set `owner.setCustomerCode(nextCustomerCode(owner.getLastName()))` before saving; added the `nextCustomerCode` helper that builds `String.format("%s-%04d", last3, findAllOwners().size() + 1)`. It's assigned only on create (not on update), so the code is immutable once set.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `customerCode` property to the `Owner` schema; the generated `OwnerDto` picks it up and MapStruct auto-maps it (same field name on entity and DTO), so it serializes on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.
- **Schema SQL** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added a `customer_code` column to the `owners` table. Tests run on hsqldb.

Notes: the LAST3 computation safely handles last names shorter than three characters (`substring(0, min(3, len))`). The sequence is derived from the live owner count at creation time, which gives the required global +1 progression the acceptance test asserts.
